title: Runbook: publish-release.mjs does not run the same gates as release.yml (omits release-provenance and check-breaking-bump --pair)
description: Raised while running the 0.13.0 release (QCLI-433, DEC-169). docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, section "Publishing locally when CI cannot", says scripts/publish-release.mjs performs the same fail-closed, receipt-gated publish as release.yml. Read from the script, that is false: publish-release.mjs runs version parity (requireVersionParity), the opum-cli-e2e receipt gate (requireQualification, binding version/commit/releaseRunId and the seven tarball sha256), the native-execution receipt (validateReceipt), candidate-bundle integrity, and the launcher substitution check -- but it imports and runs neither release-provenance.mjs (--pre/--post) nor check-breaking-bump.mjs --pair, both of which release.yml runs. A reader taking the local route unknowingly drops two CI gates. Found at quest-cli main 5996e24a during the 0.13.0 publish (the two gates were run by hand there: release-provenance --pre with GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v0.13.0, and check-breaking-bump --pair, both exit 0). Do not fix inside the release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md no longer asserts that scripts/publish-release.mjs runs the same gates as release.yml; it names the gate set each route runs.

The runbook states that release-provenance (--pre/--post) and check-breaking-bump --pair run only in release.yml, and that the local route must run them by hand -- including the release-provenance --pre form, which needs GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v<version>.
A reader following the local route can enumerate every gate release.yml would have run and where each one is covered.
